svg.title: Claim Check
svg.desc: Claim Check. Put the large payload in storage and send only a reference through the broker. Step 1, A message too big: Intake publishes the 25 MB claim with its photos as one message; the 256 KB topic rejects it. Step 2, Store, then send a check: First upload the 25 MB payload to blob storage, then publish a 1 KB claim check that points to it. Step 3, Redeem the claim check: Each consumer fetches the payload by its reference and checks the sha256; the filter reads metadata. Step 4, Lifecycle and safety: Delete the payload once both are done or after 30 days; a check that finds it gone is dead-lettered.

g.text: Intake publishes the 25 MB claim with its photos as one message; the 256 KB topic rejects it.
First upload the 25 MB payload to blob storage, then publish a 1 KB claim check that points to it.
Each consumer fetches the payload by its reference and checks the sha256; the filter reads metadata.
Delete the payload once both are done or after 30 days; a check that finds it gone is dead-lettered.
MESSAGE SIZE VS THE 256 KB LIMIT
